scripts.script:
-- auto win (end) - HairWorld StageX12
local env = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G
if env.AutoWinCleanup then pcall(env.AutoWinCleanup) end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UIS     = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TS      = game:GetService("TweenService")
local WS      = game:GetService("Workspace")
local LP      = Players.LocalPlayer

local alive, loopOn = true, false
local conns = {}
local function track(c) table.insert(conns, c) return c end

-- ===== finding the pad =====
local function findPad()
    local o = WS
    for _, name in ipairs({"HairWorld", "StageX12", "WinPads", "WinPad"}) do
        o = o and o:FindFirstChild(name)
    end
    return o
end

local function padPart(pad)
    if pad:IsA("BasePart") then return pad end
    return pad:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
end

local function autoWin()
    local pad = findPad()
    if not pad then warn("[autowin] pad not found at workspace.HairWorld.StageX12.WinPads.WinPad") return false end
    local part = padPart(pad)
    local char = LP.Character
    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not part or not root then return false end

    root.CFrame = part.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, part.Size.Y / 2 + 3, 0)
    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero

    if firetouchinterest then
        for _, p in ipairs(pad:IsA("BasePart") and {pad} or pad:GetDescendants()) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") then
                pcall(firetouchinterest, root, p, 0)
                pcall(firetouchinterest, root, p, 1)
            end
        end
    end
    return true
end

-- ===== gui =====
local C = {
    bg = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 20), panel = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 29),
    row = Color3.fromRGB(26, 26, 38), rowHi = Color3.fromRGB(36, 36, 52),
    off = Color3.fromRGB(48, 48, 66), text = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 245),
    a1 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 100, 255), a2 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 180, 255),
    red = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 110),
}
local function new(class, props, parent)
    local o = Instance.new(class)
    for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
    if parent then o.Parent = parent end
    return o
end
local function corner(o, r) return new("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r)}, o) end
local function gradient(o, rot)
    return new("UIGradient", {Color = ColorSequence.new(C.a1, C.a2), Rotation = rot or 0}, o)
end

local gui = new("ScreenGui", {
    Name = tostring(math.random(100000, 999999)),
    ResetOnSpawn = false, DisplayOrder = 999,
    ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
})
local mounted = false
for _, fn in ipairs({
    function() return gethui and gethui() end,
    function() return game:GetService("CoreGui") end,
    function() return LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 5) end,
}) do
    local ok, p = pcall(fn)
    if ok and p then
        local ok2 = pcall(function() gui.Parent = p end)
        if ok2 and gui.Parent == p then mounted = true break end
    end
end
if not mounted then warn("[autowin] couldn't mount gui") return end

local main = new("Frame", {
    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
    Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 170),
    Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
    BackgroundColor3 = C.bg, BorderSizePixel = 0,
}, gui)
corner(main, 14)
gradient(new("UIStroke", {Thickness = 1.5, Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)}, main), 45)

local header = new("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36), BackgroundColor3 = C.panel, BorderSizePixel = 0,
}, main)
corner(header, 14)
new("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -14),
    BackgroundColor3 = C.panel, BorderSizePixel = 0,
}, header)
for n = 1, 3 do
    local d = new("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 8), Position = UDim2.new(0, 14 + (n - 1) * 14, 0.5, -4),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, header)
    corner(d, 4)
    gradient(d, 45 * n)
end

-- drag
do
    header.Active = true
    local dragging, start, startPos
    track(header.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging, start, startPos = true, i.Position, main.Position
        end
    end))
    track(UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if dragging and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            local d = i.Position - start
            main.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
        end
    end))
    track(UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = false
        end
    end))
end

local list = new("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, -50), Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 44),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
}, main)
new("UIListLayout", {Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)}, list)

-- Auto Win (end) button
local winBtn = new("TextButton", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40), BackgroundColor3 = C.row,
    Text = "Auto Win (end)", TextColor3 = C.text,
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 13,
    AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0,
}, list)
corner(winBtn, 8)
gradient(new("UIStroke", {Thickness = 1.5, Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)}, winBtn), 0)
track(winBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() winBtn.BackgroundColor3 = C.rowHi end))
track(winBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() winBtn.BackgroundColor3 = C.row end))
track(winBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local ok = autoWin()
    winBtn.Text = ok and "Teleported!" or "Pad not found"
    task.delay(1.5, function() winBtn.Text = "Auto Win (end)" end)
end))

-- Loop toggle
local row = new("TextButton", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36), BackgroundColor3 = C.row,
    Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0,
}, list)
corner(row, 8)
new("TextLabel", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -64, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "Loop Auto Win", TextColor3 = C.text,
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextSize = 12, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
}, row)
local sw = new("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, 20), Position = UDim2.new(1, -50, 0.5, -10),
    BackgroundColor3 = C.off, BorderSizePixel = 0,
}, row)
corner(sw, 10)
local sg = gradient(sw, 0)
sg.Enabled = false
local knob = new("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 14), Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -7),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0,
}, sw)
corner(knob, 7)

track(row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    loopOn = not loopOn
    sg.Enabled = loopOn
    sw.BackgroundColor3 = loopOn and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or C.off
    TS:Create(knob, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
        Position = loopOn and UDim2.new(1, -17, 0.5, -7) or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -7)
    }):Play()
end))

task.spawn(function()
    while alive do
        task.wait(1)
        if loopOn then pcall(autoWin) end
    end
end)

-- RightShift to hide/show
track(UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
    if i.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift and not UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then
        main.Visible = not main.Visible
    end
end))

env.AutoWinCleanup = function()
    alive, loopOn = false, false
    for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end)
    env.AutoWinCleanup = nil
end

print("[autowin] loaded - RightShift hides/shows")

scripts.script:
script.Name = "TextureReplacer"

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "TextureReplacerGui"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = playerGui

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Name = "Main"
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 340, 0, 190)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -170, 0.5, -95)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 36)
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
frame.Parent = screenGui
Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 36)
title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 6)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "Texture Replacer by r3dDUDE and AI"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextSize = 20
title.Parent = frame

local input = Instance.new("TextBox")
input.Name = "IdInput"
input.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 40)
input.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 50)
input.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
input.BorderSizePixel = 0
input.PlaceholderText = "Enter image ID"
input.Text = ""
input.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
input.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 160)
input.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
input.TextSize = 16
input.ClearTextOnFocus = false
input.Parent = frame
Instance.new("UICorner", input).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

local status = Instance.new("TextLabel")
status.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 24)
status.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 98)
status.BackgroundTransparency = 1
status.Text = ""
status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 190)
status.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
status.TextSize = 14
status.Parent = frame

local function makeButton(text, pos, color)
	local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
	b.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -15, 0, 40)
	b.Position = pos
	b.BackgroundColor3 = color
	b.BorderSizePixel = 0
	b.Text = text
	b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	b.TextSize = 16
	b.AutoButtonColor = true
	b.Parent = frame
	Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	return b
end

local applyButton = makeButton("Apply", UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 135), Color3.fromRGB(60, 140, 90))
local resetButton = makeButton("Reset", UDim2.new(0.5, 5, 0, 135), Color3.fromRGB(150, 60, 60))

local originalTextures = {}
local createdOverlays = {}

local function setStatus(msg, color)
	status.Text = msg
	status.TextColor3 = color or Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 190)
end

local function parseId(text)
	return string.match(text, "%d+")
end

local function applyImage(id)
	local assetUrl = "rbxassetid://" .. id
	local count = 0

	for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("Texture") or obj:IsA("Decal") then
			local part = obj.Parent
			if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
				if obj.Transparency > 0 then
					local overlay = Instance.new("Decal")
					overlay.Name = "ReplacerOverlay"
					overlay.Face = obj.Face
					overlay.Texture = assetUrl
					overlay.Transparency = 0
					overlay.Color3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
					overlay.Parent = part
					table.insert(createdOverlays, overlay)
				else
					table.insert(originalTextures, { obj = obj, texture = obj.Texture })
					obj.Texture = assetUrl
				end
				count += 1
			end
		end
	end

	return count
end

local function resetAll()
	for _, data in ipairs(originalTextures) do
		if data.obj and data.obj.Parent then
			data.obj.Texture = data.texture
		end
	end
	table.clear(originalTextures)

	for _, overlay in ipairs(createdOverlays) do
		if overlay then
			overlay:Destroy()
		end
	end
	table.clear(createdOverlays)
end

applyButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local id = parseId(input.Text)
	if not id then
		setStatus("Error: enter a valid ID", Color3.fromRGB(230, 90, 90))
		return
	end

	local count = applyImage(id)
	setStatus("Objects replaced: " .. count, Color3.fromRGB(120, 220, 140))
end)

resetButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	resetAll()
	setStatus("Textures reset", Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 190))
end)

                    return _G.SunLoopActive and LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character == initialCharacter and initialCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") and initialCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").Health > 0
                end

                local function dropCurrentTool()
                    if not isCharacterValid() then return end
                    local heldTool = initialCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
                    if heldTool then
                        for _, desc in ipairs(heldTool:GetDescendants()) do
                            if desc:IsA("BasePart") then

                    end

                task.wait(0.3)

                -- STEP 2: Fast Flashlight Loop

                    end

                -- STEP 3: Slow Flashlight Loop
                for i = 1, 15 do
                    if not isCharacterValid() then break end
                    if EquipToolEvent then EquipToolEvent:FireServer("Flashlight") end
                    
                    local activeFlashlight = backpack:WaitForChild("Flashlight", 2)
                    if activeFlashlight and LocalPlayer.Character == initialCharacter then

                sunBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(38, 38, 45)
            end)

            sunBtn.Text = "SUN [OFF]"

-- Unified Chat System Payload Broadcaster
local function sendLocalChat(text)
    task.spawn(function()
        if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
            local channel = TextChatService.TextChannels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
            if channel then channel:SendAsync(text) end
        else
            local cEvent = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents") and ReplicatedStorage.DefaultChatSystemChatEvents:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest")
            if cEvent then cEvent:FireServer(text, "All") end
        end
    end)
end

-- Core Tool Assembly Engine
local function buildCustomTools()
    local backpack = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("Backpack")
    
    -- 1. Assemble Ragdoll Tool Instance
    if not backpack:FindFirstChild("Ragdoll (Sit)") then
        local RagdollTool = Instance.new("Tool")
        RagdollTool.Name = "Ragdoll (Sit)"
        RagdollTool.RequiresHandle = false
        RagdollTool.CanBeDropped = false
        
        RagdollTool.Activated:Connect(function()
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                hum.Sit = not hum.Sit
                if hum.Sit then 
                    hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated) 
                end
            end
        end)
        RagdollTool.Parent = backpack
    end
    
    -- 2. Assemble Face Slam Tool Instance
    if not backpack:FindFirstChild("Face Slam") then
        local SlamTool = Instance.new("Tool")
        SlamTool.Name = "Face Slam"
        SlamTool.RequiresHandle = false
        SlamTool.CanBeDropped = false
        
        local activeConnection = nil
        local activeAnchors = {}
        
        SlamTool.Activated:Connect(function()
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            
            if not hum or not root or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
            
            -- Clear old tracking frames if activated back-to-back
            if activeConnection then activeConnection:Disconnect() activeConnection = nil end
            for _, p in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                if p:IsA("BasePart") and activeAnchors[p] then p.Anchored = false end
            end
            table.clear(activeAnchors)
            
            -- Broadcast chat string payload
            sendLocalChat("slam*")
            
            -- Unlock stand-up animation states
            root.Anchored = true
            hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)
            
            -- Raycast Downward to Find Ground Positioning
            local startPos = root.Position + (root.CFrame.LookVector * 7)
            local rp = RaycastParams.new()
            rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = {char}
            rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            local res = workspace:Raycast(startPos + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0), Vector3.new(0, -20, 0), rp)
            local targetY = res and res.Position.Y or startPos.Y
            
            -- Target Squish Framework Check
            if res and res.Instance then
                local hitModel = res.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
                if hitModel and hitModel ~= char and hitModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
                    local eh = hitModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    local er = hitModel:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if eh and er then
                        eh:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)
                        er.CFrame = er.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0)
                        er.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, -40, 0)
                    end
                end
            end
            
            -- Position horizontally flat face-first on the surface
            local finalCFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(startPos.X, targetY + 0.5, startPos.Z)) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(root.Orientation.Y), 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0)
            root.CFrame = finalCFrame
            task.wait(0.02)
            
            -- Lock position completely on target flat layout
            for _, p in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                if p:IsA("BasePart") then activeAnchors[p] = true p.Anchored = true end
            end
            
            -- Listen for player jumping to execute upright stabilization sequence
            local jumpConn
            jumpConn = UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
                for _, p in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                    if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.Anchored = false end
                end
                table.clear(activeAnchors)
                root.Anchored = false
                
                if char and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                    hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
                    task.wait(0.05)
                    root.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(root.Orientation.Y), 0)
                end
                if jumpConn then jumpConn:Disconnect() end
            end)
            activeConnection = jumpConn
        end)
        SlamTool.Parent = backpack
    end
end

ghostPart.Transparency = 0.5                  
ghostPart.Anchored = true
ghostPart.CanCollide = false
ghostPart.CanQuery = false 
ghostPart.CastShadow = false
ghostPart.Parent = Camera 

local function updateGhostAppearance()
	if currentShape == "Circle" then
		ghostPart.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		ghostPart.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, shapeSize, shapeSize) 
		ghostPart.Orientation = Vector3.new(0, 0, 90) 
	elseif currentShape == "Cube" then
		ghostPart.Shape = Enum.PartType.Block
		ghostPart.Size = Vector3.new(shapeSize, 0.5, shapeSize)
		ghostPart.Orientation = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	elseif currentShape == "Triangle" then
		ghostPart.Shape = Enum.PartType.Block
		ghostPart.Size = Vector3.new(shapeSize, 0.5, shapeSize) 
		ghostPart.Orientation = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
end
updateGhostAppearance()
-- Menu State Modifications
local shapesList = {"Circle", "Cube", "Triangle"}
local shapeIndex = 1
toggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	shapeIndex = shapeIndex + 1
	if shapeIndex > #shapesList then shapeIndex = 1 end
	currentShape = shapesList[shapeIndex]
	toggleBtn.Text = "Shape: " .. currentShape
	updateGhostAppearance()
end)

sizeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

end)

neutralBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	previewActive = not previewActive
	if previewActive then
		neutralBtn.Text = "Preview: ON"

	else
		neutralBtn.Text = "Preview: OFF (Neutral)"
		neutralBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(163, 62, 62)
		ghostPart.Transparency = 1
		coordLabel.Text = "System: Idle"
	end
end)

-- 3. INTERPOLATION VECTOR SEQUENCE ARRAY GENERATOR
local function generateCoordinateQueue(center2D)
	local queue = {}
	
	local function addLineToQueue(p1, p2, steps)
		for i = 0, steps do
			table.insert(queue, p1:Lerp(p2, i / steps))
		end
	end

	if currentShape == "Circle" then
		local stepDistance = 2.5 
		for r = shapeSize, 0, -stepDistance do
			local currentPoints = math.max(8, math.floor(density * (r / shapeSize) * 2))
			for i = 1, currentPoints do
				local rad = math.rad((i / currentPoints) * 360)
				table.insert(queue, center2D + Vector2.new(math.cos(rad), math.sin(rad)) * r)
			end
		end
		
	elseif currentShape == "Cube" then
		local steps = density
		local half = shapeSize / 2
		for i = 0, steps do
			local t = i / steps
			local leftX = center2D.X - half
			local rightX = center2D.X + half
			local currentZ = (center2D.Y + half) - (t * shapeSize)
			addLineToQueue(Vector2.new(leftX, currentZ), Vector2.new(rightX, currentZ), steps)
		end
		
	elseif currentShape == "Triangle" then
		local steps = density
		local top = center2D + Vector2.new(0, shapeSize)
		local bottomLeft = center2D + Vector2.new(-shapeSize, -shapeSize)
		local bottomRight = center2D + Vector2.new(shapeSize, -shapeSize)
		
		for i = 0, steps do
			local t = i / steps
			local leftPoint = top:Lerp(bottomLeft, t)
			local rightPoint = top:Lerp(bottomRight, t)
			addLineToQueue(leftPoint, rightPoint, math.floor(steps * t))
		end
	end
	
	return queue
end

-- 4. FREE-CLICK MULTI-THREAD INPUT CONNECTOR
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed or not previewActive or not Mouse.Hit then return end
	
	-- Captures user inputs (Works concurrently without checking an active print lock)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		activePrintsCount = activePrintsCount + 1
		
		-- Immediately lock the center coordinate for this specific thread branch
		local targetCenter = Vector2.new(ghostPart.Position.X, ghostPart.Position.Z)
		local coordinatePipeline = generateCoordinateQueue(targetCenter)
		
		task.spawn(function()
			for index, coordinate in ipairs(coordinatePipeline) do
				coordLabel.Text = string.format("Active Prints: %d | Printing...", activePrintsCount)
				PlaceObjectEvent:FireServer(ITEM_NAME, ROTATION, coordinate, MODE)
				task.wait(0.01) 
			end
			
			activePrintsCount = math.max(0, activePrintsCount - 1)
			if activePrintsCount == 0 then
				coordLabel.Text = "All Prints Finished!"
				task.wait(0.5)
				if previewActive then coordLabel.Text = "Click Ground to Print" end
			else
				coordLabel.Text = string.format("Active Prints: %d", activePrintsCount)
			end
		end)
	end
end)

-- 5. REAL-TIME MOUSE POSITION HOOK
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if not previewActive or not Mouse.Hit then
		ghostPart.Transparency = 1
		return
	end
	
	-- Keep the visual preview ghost box active and tracking even if threads are running in the background
	local lookPos = Mouse.Hit.Position
	ghostPart.Transparency = 0.5
	ghostPart.Position = Vector3.new(lookPos.X, lookPos.Y + (ghostPart.Size.Y / 2), lookPos.Z)
end)

scripts.title: Neverlose [UI Library]
scripts.script:
repeat task.wait() until game:IsLoaded()

local success, NeverloseUI = pcall(function()
    return loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://script.roscripts.io/Ci0HsqM"))()
end)

if not success or not NeverloseUI then
    warn("Failed to load NeverloseUI.")
    return
end

local Window
local function SafeCall(callback)
    local ok, result = pcall(callback)
    if not ok then
        warn("[NeverloseUI] " .. tostring(result))
    end
    return ok, result
end

SafeCall(function()
    NeverloseUI:AddTheme({
        Name = "Ocean Blue",
        Accent = Color3.fromRGB(55, 145, 255),
        Background = Color3.fromRGB(18, 21, 29),
        Secondary = Color3.fromRGB(25, 30, 42),
        Text = Color3.fromRGB(235, 242, 255),
        Border = Color3.fromRGB(45, 65, 95)
    })
end)

local created, result = SafeCall(function()
    return NeverloseUI:CreateWindow({
        Title = "Example Hub",
        Subtitle = "Blue Edition",
        Theme = "Ocean Blue",
        ToggleKeybind = Enum.KeyCode.RightShift,
        ConfigEnabled = true,
        AutoSave = true,
        AutoLoad = true,
        DraggableToggle = true
    })
end)

if not created or not result then
    warn("Failed to create the interface.")
    return
end

Window = result

local function AddTab(name, icon)
    local ok, tab = SafeCall(function()
        return Window:AddTab({
            Name = name,
            Icon = icon
        })
    end)

    if ok then
        return tab
    end

    return nil
end

local function AddSection(tab, name)
    if not tab then
        return nil
    end

    local ok, section = SafeCall(function()
        return tab:AddSection({
            Name = name
        })
    end)

    if ok then
        return section
    end

    return nil
end

local HomeTab = AddTab("Home", "house")
local SettingsTab = AddTab("Settings", "settings")

local MainSection = AddSection(HomeTab, "Main")

if MainSection then
    SafeCall(function()
        MainSection:AddParagraph({
            Title = "Welcome",
            Content = "Welcome to Example Hub."
        })
    end)

    SafeCall(function()
        MainSection:AddButton({
            Name = "Show Notification",
            Callback = function()
                SafeCall(function()
                    NeverloseUI:Notify({
                        Title = "Example Hub",
                        Content = "The interface is working.",
                        Duration = 3
                    })
                end)
            end
        })
    end)

    SafeCall(function()
        MainSection:AddToggle({
            Name = "Example Toggle",
            Default = false,
            Callback = function(value)
                print("Example Toggle:", value)
            end
        })
    end)

    SafeCall(function()
        MainSection:AddSlider({
            Name = "Example Slider",
            Min = 0,
            Max = 100,
            Default = 50,
            Callback = function(value)
                print("Slider Value:", value)
            end
        })
    end)

    SafeCall(function()
        MainSection:AddDropdown({
            Name = "Example Dropdown",
            Options = {"Option A", "Option B", "Option C"},
            Default = "Option A",
            Callback = function(value)
                print("Selected Option:", value)
            end
        })
    end)
end

local SettingsSection = AddSection(SettingsTab, "Settings")

if SettingsSection then
    SafeCall(function()
        SettingsSection:AddToggle({
            Name = "Example Setting",
            Default = true,
            Callback = function(value)
                print("Setting Enabled:", value)
            end
        })
    end)

    SafeCall(function()
        SettingsSection:AddButton({
            Name = "Unload Interface",
            Callback = function()
                SafeCall(function()
                    NeverloseUI:Unload()
                end)
            end
        })
    end)
end

SafeCall(function()
    NeverloseUI:Notify({
        Title = "Example Hub",
        Content = "Interface loaded.",
        Duration = 3
    })
end)
